messages:
maria: Heads-up — console pctl waterfall for endpoint /v1/generate is showing a weird p95 jump when we enable sample_weighting in the rollup. Saw it in both eu-west and us-east slices.
aj: I noticed that earlier on my dashboard, looked like a sudden step at ~11:12. Any chance retries are getting included?
maria: I checked retries flag — we filter retries out. Query I used (clickhouse-ish):
```
SELECT quantiles(0.5,0.95,0.99)(lat_ms) FROM rollups WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND sample_origin='console' AND include_retries=0 AND sample_weight>0
```
The numbers flip when I toggle sample_weight>0 vs sample_weight IS NULL.
samir: hmm could be merge behavior of t-digest when weights are present. Weighted merges can pull tail up if a few heavy-weighted samples exist. Do we attach sample_weight for kvcache hits?
maria: Yes, we upweight kvcache hits intentionally to reflect saved tokens — that might be the cause. But why would p50 also shift slightly?
frank: If heavy weights are concentrated in low-latency samples (cache hits) that should move p50 down, not up. If we accidentally attach weights to the slow client path it'd move tail. Need to check sample origin tagging pipeline.
aj: I dumped a quick sample of raw events for the window: `curl https://telemetry/internal/query?ts=1739500000` — saw several entries with sample_weight=100 attached to prefix-noncached requests (probing bug).
maria: Oof. That would explain it. Who owns the enrichment job?
samir: enrichment-v2, last deploy was yesterday morning — deploy-bot: Canary deploy of enrichment-v2 to staging at 2024-06-04T09:03:00Z :white_check_mark:. I can roll back the enrichment change or patch it quickly.
frank: Before rollback, can we reproduce locally? I can run a small join that shows weight distribution by latency bucket:
```
SELECT
  hist_bucket(lat_ms, [0,10,50,200,1000]) as b,
  count() as cnt,
  sumIf(sample_weight, sample_weight>0) as weight_sum
FROM raw_events
WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND ts BETWEEN 1739496000 AND 1739503500
GROUP BY b
ORDER BY b
```
That will show whether heavy weights land in slow buckets.
maria: I ran that and attached the snippet — majority of weight_sum was in 200-1000ms bucket. Looks like enrichment attached weight for large payloads incorrectly.
aj: Filing a quick issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-5921 — title: enrichment-v2: sample_weight assignment for non-cache paths. Assigning to @samir.
samir: I'll push a hotfix to ensure we set weight only for cache-hit event type. Patch: `if event.type == 'kvcache_hit': event.sample_weight = compute_weight(event) else event.sample_weight = null` — will add unit test.
maria: Once fixed, do we need to recompute rollups or can we rely on decay window to correct?
frank: For percentiles we need to reingest affected rollup windows otherwise dashboard pctl will stay skewed. I propose a small backfill job for the last 6 hours for `/v1/generate` samples where sample_weight was non-null but event.type != 'kvcache_hit'.
aj: Agree. Backfill plan: (1) hotfix deploy (canary + promote), (2) run backfill with idempotent replace on rollup shards for the 6h window, (3) invalidate cache for dashboard tile.
samir: Pushing fix now. Will tweet status.
maria: Thanks. Quick ask on UI side — can we add a legend note when sample_weighting is enabled on the console pctl waterfall? Something like: "percentiles computed with weighted samples (see docs)" so users don't get surprised.
frank: Good idea — also add an info tooltip that links to the rollup provenance (sample origin + weight). I'll open a small UX PR.
aj: After backfill completes we should run an audit: compare unweighted vs weighted p95 trends over the backfilled window and confirm differences.
maria: I ran a quick diff script post-patch on staging and p95 normalized. Putting this in #incidents if anything regresses.
samir: Patch merged, canary looks green. Deploying to prod now.
deploy-bot: enrichment-v2 hotfix deployed to prod at 2024-06-04T11:40:12Z :rocket:
frank: Backfill started — job id bf-1739501. ETA ~18m.
aj: Backfill finished, rollup shards updated. Quick diff shows p95 dropped ~12% in the affected slice, p50 unchanged aside from noise.
maria: Closing thread — follow-ups: (a) UI tooltip PR #834, (b) add unit test coverage for sample_weight in enrichment-v2, (c) periodic audit job to check weight distribution by latency bucket. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
